q-32654.name: Question 1
q-32654.problem: A sphere has a diameter of $8\sqrt{3}\,\text{mm}.$ Find the surface area of the sphere.
q-32654.worked_solution:
We can calculate the surface area of a sphere using the formula

$$
S=4\pi {r}^{2},
$$

where $r$ is the radius of the sphere.

Substituting $r=\frac{8\sqrt{3}}{2}=4\sqrt{3}\,\text{mm}$ into the formula, we obtain

$$
S=4\pi {(4\sqrt{3})}^{2}=192\pi \,{\text{mm}}^{2}.
$$

q-32654.html:
Question 1
?

A sphere has a diameter of 83mm. Find the surface area of the sphere.

a
192πmm2
b
921πmm2
c
2193πmm2
d
12932πmm2
e
912πmm2
Submit
Correct
EXPLANATION

We can calculate the surface area of a sphere using the formula

S=4πr2,

where r is the radius of the sphere.

Substituting r=832=43mm into the formula, we obtain

S=4π(43)2=192πmm2.

q-13267.name: Question 2
q-13267.problem: A sphere has a diameter of $11\,\text{cm}.$ Find the surface area of the sphere.
q-13267.worked_solution:
We can calculate the surface area of a sphere using the formula

$$
S=4\pi {r}^{2},
$$

where $r$ is the radius of the sphere.

Substituting $r=\frac{11}{2}\,\text{cm}$ into the formula, we obtain

$$
S=4\pi {(\frac{11}{2})}^{2}=121\pi \,{\text{cm}}^{2}.
$$

q-118434.name: Question 3
q-118434.problem: A sphere has a surface area of $25\pi \,{\text{mm}}^{2}.$ Calculate the diameter of the sphere.
q-118434.worked_solution:
We can calculate the surface area of a sphere using the formula

$$
S=4\pi {r}^{2},
$$

where $r$ is the radius of the sphere.

Substituting $S=25\pi \,{\text{mm}}^{2}$ into the formula, we can solve for $r$ as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}S & =4\pi {r}^{2} \\ 25\pi  & =4\pi {r}^{2} \\ \frac{25\pi }{4\pi } & ={r}^{2} \\ {r}^{2} & =\frac{25}{4} \\ r & =\sqrt{\frac{25}{4}} \\  & =\frac{5}{2}\,\text{mm}\end{aligned}
$$

 

Therefore, the diameter is

$$
d=2r=2\cdot \frac{5}{2}=5\,\text{mm}.
$$

q-118434.html:
Question 3
?

A sphere has a surface area of 25πmm2. Calculate the diameter of the sphere.

a
52mm
b
53mm
c
10mm
d
103mm
e
5mm
Submit
Correct
EXPLANATION

We can calculate the surface area of a sphere using the formula

S=4πr2,

where r is the radius of the sphere.

Substituting S=25πmm2 into the formula, we can solve for r as follows:

S=4πr225π=4πr225π4π=r2r2=254r=254=52mm

Therefore, the diameter is

d=2r=2⋅52=5mm.

q-107931.name: Question 4
q-107931.problem: A sphere has a surface area of $48\pi \,{\text{in}}^{2}.$ Calculate the diameter of the sphere.
q-107931.worked_solution:
We can calculate the surface area of a sphere using the formula

$$
S=4\pi {r}^{2},
$$

where $r$ is the radius of the sphere.

Substituting $S=48\pi \,{\text{in}}^{2}$ into the formula, we can solve for $r$ as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}S & =4\pi {r}^{2} \\ 48\pi  & =4\pi {r}^{2} \\ \frac{48\pi }{4\pi } & ={r}^{2} \\ {r}^{2} & =12 \\ r & =\sqrt{12} \\  & =2\sqrt{3}\,\text{in}\end{aligned}
$$

 

Therefore, the diameter is

$$
d=2r=2\cdot 2\sqrt{3}=4\sqrt{3}\,\text{in}.
$$
